task.question: What service starts on May 25, 2026, in rail transport between London and Stirling?
task.evidence: 25 May – Lumo, an open access operator, starts passenger services between London and Stirling.

answer: On May 25, 2026, a new high-speed rail service is set to start operating between London and Stirling, significantly reducing travel times and improving connectivity between the two cities. FINAL: high-speed rail service.
